description: Frozen cross-layer boundary findings from the 2026-09-22 layer-boundary-gate task. Each entry is known, reviewed debt with a stated ratchet; the gate (scripts/harness/check-boundaries.mjs --strict --baseline config/boundary-baseline.json) blocks any NEW violation but lets these stay tracked until they are refactored or re-approved. Do not add an entry to silence a new finding — fix it or get explicit maintainer approval. Entries must keep matching a real finding: the gate fails --strict on stale entries (2026-09-23) so they cannot whitelist a reintroduced import. The three backend/modules/auth/* -> modules/system/iam/user entries were removed on 2026-09-23 once the pkg/contracts/authuser port landed and production code stopped importing the iam model. The four auth -> system/components/shared/list-page.css entries were removed on 2026-10-11 by executing their own ratchet: the stylesheet was promoted to frontend/src/assets/list-page.css, so auth pages no longer reach into the system module for a shared style and the misleading modules/system/components/ directory is gone. The last entry (platform/widgets.tsx -> system/iam/menu/api) was removed on 2026-10-26 by executing its own ratchet: MenuNode now lives in frontend/src/api/menu.ts, which is the public-contract location named by docs/designs/REPOSITORY_LAYOUT.md §8.1, so the platform module no longer imports a system subdomain path.
